title: On-prem entitlement flexband and security questionnaire response playbook
creator: Asha Raman
description: Experiment framework to validate a flexible licensing band model and standardized security questionnaire responses for private/VPC and on-prem customers, while defining rational support tiers and upgrade cadence options.
background: Enterprise pipeline increasingly requests bespoke on-prem pricing and long upgrade windows. Sales and Legal report friction in negotiations due to unclear license floors, support SLAs, and slow security questionnaire turnaround. This project creates an experiment and playbook to reduce friction and quantify revenue uplift.
goals: Validate elastic license fee bands for on-prem deployments that reduce negotiation cycles
Define three support tiers aligned to enterprise SLAs and measurable attachment rates
Build canonical answers and exceptions for common security questionnaire items to reduce RFP turnaround time
Specify upgrade cadence options (quarterly/biannual/annual) with pricing and migration credits
success_metrics: Pilot acceptance rate of flexband within 60 days >= 40%
Average contract value uplift >= 8% for customers choosing longer commitments or premium support
Security questionnaire turnaround time <= 5 business days for templated items
Support tier attach rate >= 25% for new on-prem deals
approach: Run a 3-arm pilot: (A) fixed tiered license, (B) flexband with defined min/target/max bands, (C) flexband plus managed upgrades. Coordinate with legal to pre-approve SOW snippets and security answers. Pilot with 6-8 target prospects across finance, healthcare, and telecom. Collect qualitative feedback from sales and engineering post-signature.
deliverables: Support tier definitions and SLA matrix (Standard, Premier, Enterprise)
Security questionnaire canonical answers with flags for "engineering review required" cases
Upgrade cadence policy and optional managed-upgrade add-on pricing
Contract playbooks: sample MSA/SOW clauses + negotiation scripts for sales
risks: Legal pushback on variable license terms and revenue recognition complexity
Billing system complexity to track flexband floors and true-ups
Engineering/QA effort to support longer upgrade windows and backports
Customers demanding custom security commitments requiring product changes
